rows.exact_source_record: ὁ δὲ θεός μου πληρώσει πᾶσαν χρείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ ⸂τὸ πλοῦτος⸃ αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

rows.rationale: Preserves the whole group and the specified imperial household without identifying occupations.
rows.before: All the saints greet you, especially those of Caesar's household.
rows.after: All the saints send you greetings, especially those of Caesar's household.
rows.tsw_comparator: All the saints greet you, especially those of the emperor’s household.
rows.exact_source_record: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι, μάλιστα δὲ οἱ ἐκ τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας.

rows.rationale: Retains the singular spirit addressed to the plural community and the short ending.
rows.before: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
rows.after: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
rows.tsw_comparator: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
rows.exact_source_record: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ ⸂τοῦ πνεύματος⸃ ⸀ὑμῶν.
